items.t: Fuel gauge reads wrong and SUV can run out of gas
items.job: Replace fuel level sending unit (often with fuel pump module)

items.t: Driver door switch can overheat and catch fire (recall)
Door switches stop controlling windows and locks
Rear air suspension sags or leaks
items.note: RepairPal total is about $445-$590 per spring.

items.t: AWD binds, hops or howls in tight turns
items.job: Service or repair AWD differential/transfer case
items.note: A fluid change is cheap; one owner was quoted over $2,000 for hardware repairs.

items.t: StabiliTrak light comes on and engine power drops
items.note: RepairPal total is about $410-$640. Diagnose first, since a sensor may be the cause instead.
RepairPal total is about $195-$350 per coil.

items.t: Lifter failure on the V8 causes misfire
items.job: Replace AFM lifters (and camshaft if damaged)

items.t: Burnt exhaust valve on the inline-six
items.job: Remove and repair cylinder head (valve job)

items.t: Engine shuts off if the key is bumped
Power steering lines rust through and leak
items.job: Replace power steering pressure and return hose assembly
items.note: Aftermarket line sets run about $55–$90; GM assembly listings run $265 and up. Labor hours are based on YourMechanic, which quotes about $880 (5.3L/6.0L) to $1,100 (4.2L) for 2006–2009. Replace pressure and return lines together.
